variants.headline: Home world sends punitive expedition
variants.sub: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has sent a punitive expedition. Dispatch and arrival are different events, and this report establishes only the former. Readers considering {target} should not be asked to accept an invented landing, confrontation or account of force as part of the news of its departure.

A claim to authority becomes especially important to examine when it takes a punitive form. Our convictions require attention to legitimacy and responsibility, without turning that political argument into an invented battle. The colony deserves a case about power that can be made without adding events to the record.

We judge {target} adversely. Punitive power demands an exacting political standard, and the dispatch is an appropriate occasion to question the quality and fairness of the responsibility being exercised. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.
